shared.authentication: Use your aio-proxy API key as a Bearer token when authentication is enabled.

listModels.title: List models
listModels.description: Lists the models currently available through aio-proxy. Try It runs in your browser, so the selected server must allow cross-origin requests, and an HTTPS documentation page cannot call an HTTP server because browsers block mixed content.
listModels.note: Agent negotiation and client_version catalogs are excluded from this page.

createChatCompletion.title: Create a chat completion
createChatCompletion.description: Creates a chat completion with the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API. Set `stream: true` to receive a streaming response. Requests are parsed against this endpoint's schema. A same-protocol provider with raw capability receives the raw-forwarded request after routing rewrites; cross-protocol and AI SDK providers receive a converted model request, so fields that cannot be represented by the target protocol are not forwarded. Try It runs in your browser, so the selected server must allow cross-origin requests, and an HTTPS documentation page cannot call an HTTP server because browsers block mixed content. Try It sends the request, but Scalar does not provide a separate streaming debugger; use the SSE example when the panel does not render events.
